purpose: Teach: 色素/躍動/網膜/植林/海中/調剤/産卵/堆積

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、皮膚の色素異常を医療チームで診ます
lines.en: Ren, we'll be having our medical team evaluate any skin pigmentation irregularities.
lines.style: Steady, professional opening. Clear articulation on the medical terms. Warm but clinical—the tone of someone who explains complex things plainly without talking down. Slight pause before the diagnosis.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者のリハビリでは躍動的な動きを医療チームで促します
lines.en: Yes, during rehabilitation we encourage dynamic, active movement—that's something the whole team will support.
lines.style: Reassuring and grounded. Slower pace on the key words. Lean slightly forward—collaborative, not prescriptive. The voice of someone who has explained this many times and still means it.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、糖尿病性網膜症のスクリーニングを医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, we'll be screening for diabetic retinopathy as part of your care with the team.
lines.style: Even tone, matter-of-fact. No softening, no alarm—just necessary information delivered with steady hands. Direct eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、病院敷地の植林計画を医療チームと環境部署で進めます
lines.en: Yes, we're also moving forward with a tree-planting initiative on the hospital grounds—partnering with our environmental department.
lines.style: Slight shift in tone—still professional but warmer, almost gentle pride. Slower pace, like she's sharing something she genuinely believes in. Breath flows more naturally.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 海中療法、つまり海水療法を、貴院、研究されてますね、先生
lines.en: Sea water therapy—I've noticed you asking about our research into that. It's something we do look into.
lines.style: Engaged but measured. Catches his curiosity without matching his energy exactly. Thoughtful pause before answering—she's considering his question seriously. Voice opens slightly, inviting him in.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、調剤ミス防止のダブルチェックを医療チームで徹底します
lines.en: Yes, we have strict double-check protocols for our pharmacy team—error prevention is non-negotiable.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Conviction on the word 'strict.' Steady rhythm, professional cadence. The voice of someone stating a principle, not apologizing for it.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、不妊治療で産卵周期、つまり排卵周期を医療チームで管理します
lines.en: Yes, for fertility treatment we carefully monitor the ovulation cycle—that's managed closely with the team.
lines.style: Gentle but precise. Slower on 'carefully' and 'closely'—tenderness without vagueness. Professional but acknowledging the weight of what's being discussed. Voice stays level and present.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、肺の堆積病変を医療チームで画像診断します
lines.en: Yes, we've done imaging diagnostics on the lung lesions—the team has been thorough in evaluation.
lines.style: Quiet, attentive closeness. Softer attack. Even pace but intimate—like she's sitting next to him, not across a desk. Honest without alarming. Slight warmth underneath the clinical language.
